plan.planSummary:
Build the S03 Contacts CRM feature: a full backend Contact CRUD service + paginated router on the existing /members prefix, backend tests, four reusable frontend UI primitives, three new Contact pages (List/Detail/Form), and the frontend service/hook/type/routing wiring — plus 5 small patch tasks (lowercase contact_type default, delete AttendeesPage, fix FacePanel thumb_url, rename MemberSearchModal→ContactPickerModal, and a correctness note folded into F02 for nickname search).

NO Alembic migration is required: all Contact snapshot columns (last_attended_at, attendance_count, weeks_absent, tier, is_active, is_regular, is_connected) already exist on the model and are created via Base.metadata.create_all in the SQLite test path. The only schema-adjacent change is the ORM default casing fix (P01), which is a Python-literal change, not a migration.

CRITICAL CORRECTION from recon: app/services/custom_fields.py exports validate_and_coerce(db, entity, raw) — there is NO validate_custom_data function. F01 MUST call validate_and_coerce (the intake's goal text names the wrong function; its constraints field is correct). audit.record signature is record(db, actor_id, action, entity, entity_id, before, after).

Dependency order: P01 (model default) → F01 (service+schemas) → F02 (router) → F03 (tests). Frontend: F04 (primitives) → F06 (services/hooks/types/routing) → F05 (pages) → P02 (delete AttendeesPage). P03 (FacePanel) and P04 (modal rename) are independent and batchable. F06 and P02 must land together/in-order to avoid a broken App.tsx import.

Auth decision (resolves recon risk #7): GET endpoints are require_volunteer; write mutations (POST/PATCH/DELETE) are require_volunteer per the intake F02 ACs (the spec models volunteers as data-entry operators); restore is require_admin; include_deleted is admin-gated at the query level. This matches the intake ACs explicitly, overriding the recon's speculative require_admin suggestion.

featureTasks.name: F01 — Backend Contact CRUD service + Contacts schemas
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria:
1. New file backend/app/services/contact_service.py exports 7 async, fully type-hinted public functions: list_contacts, get_contact_detail, create_contact, update_contact, soft_delete_contact, restore_contact, list_contact_attendance (plus private helper _display_name).
2. list_contacts(db, *, search, page, page_size, contact_type, contact_subtype, tier, is_regular, include_deleted) executes EXACTLY 2 queries (a func.count() and a paged select); clamps page>=1 and 1<=page_size<=100; default page_size=25; filters Contact.is_deleted.is_(False) unless include_deleted=True; search does or_(ilike) across first_name, last_name, nickname, AND email (nickname is the P05 correctness fix — must be present); applies equality filters for contact_type/contact_subtype/tier/is_regular only when not None; orders by Contact.last_name, Contact.first_name. Returns dict/tuple consumed by the router into PaginatedContactResponse.
3. get_contact_detail(db, contact_id, *, allow_deleted=False) raises HTTPException(404) for missing or (is_deleted and not allow_deleted). Resolves all contact_reference custom-field values via a SINGLE select(...).where(Contact.id.in_(all_ref_ids)) batched query (no N+1) into ContactReferenceChip list. Builds FaceSummary from a single ComprefaceSubject lookup (enrolled=subject is not None and enrollment_status active; sample_count; face_thumbnail_path best-effort). Builds DerivedBadges purely from snapshot columns with NULL passthrough (tier/is_active/is_regular/is_connected stay None when None). display_name from _display_name.
4. create_contact(db, payload: ContactCreate, actor_id) calls validate_and_coerce(db, 'contact', payload.custom_data) (NOT validate_custom_data — that function does not exist), constructs Contact, db.add + db.flush(), then audit.record(db, actor_id, 'contact.create', 'contact', contact.id, None, after_dict), then db.commit()+refresh. Returns (contact, warnings:list[str]). On email collision with an existing non-deleted contact, appends a non-blocking warning string to warnings — does NOT raise.
5. update_contact(db, contact_id, payload: ContactUpdate, actor_id) loads row with select(...).with_for_update() (per AGENTS.md:105); uses payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True); external_id is NOT in the assignable core field set (immutable — silently ignored if present); merges existing custom_data with incoming custom_data dict then runs validate_and_coerce on the MERGED dict; captures before-dict, applies changes, flush, audit.record('contact.update', before, after) with the diff, commit. Returns contact.
6. soft_delete_contact(db, contact_id, actor_id) is idempotent (if already is_deleted, returns without writing a second audit row / no-op); sets is_deleted=True; does NOT delete or cascade Participant rows; audit.record('contact.delete'); commit.
7. restore_contact(db, contact_id, actor_id) raises HTTPException(409) if contact.is_deleted is False; else sets is_deleted=False; audit.record('contact.restore'); commit.
8. list_contact_attendance(db, contact_id, *, page, page_size, source, event_type) raises 404 if contact missing; selects Participant join Event on Participant.event_id==Event.id filtered by Participant.contact_id; orders Event.start_at.desc() (nulls last acceptable); optional source filter on Participant.source; event_type filter tolerant if Event has no event_type column yet (guard with getattr/hasattr — Event is minimal per CN-16, event_type is an S04 column and may be absent — if absent, ignore the filter, do not crash). Returns paginated shape.
9. schemas.py gains a '# Contacts (CRUD)' section (insert AFTER the Members section, ~line 357, before the Audit section) with: ContactCore (base with first_name, last_name optional-at-base, nickname, suffix, gender, birth_date, phone, email, street_address, contact_type Literal['individual','household','organization'], contact_subtype), ContactCreate(ContactCore + custom_data: dict = {} + external_id optional), ContactUpdate (all optional, custom_data optional, NO external_id), ContactListItem, PaginatedContactResponse{total,page,page_size,items:List[ContactListItem]}, ContactDetailResponse, ContactReferenceChip{id,display_name,contact_type}, DerivedBadges{tier,is_active,is_regular,is_connected all Optional}, FaceSummary{enrolled:bool,sample_count:int,face_thumbnail_path:Optional[str]}, ContactAttendanceItem, PaginatedAttendanceResponse{total,page,page_size,items}.
10. ContactCore has a Pydantic model_validator(mode='after') that relaxes the last_name-required rule when contact_type in ('household','organization') (those need only one of name fields) but requires both first_name and last_name for 'individual'; a birth_date field_validator rejects future dates (> today). ContactDetailResponse and all response models use model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True).
11. ContactListItem includes display_name (so ContactPickerModal/MemberSearchModal items branch keeps working — recon risk #6) plus tier, is_regular, is_connected, face_thumbnail_path, contact_type, contact_subtype, email, phone, nickname.
12. Anti-spin: NO new Alembic migration file is created. NO server_default added to any column. contact_service.py imports audit.record from app.services.audit and validate_and_coerce from app.services.custom_fields ONLY — no import from any router or app.dependencies (CN-25). utc_now() used for any timestamp the service sets.
featureTasks.filesToChange: CREATE backend/app/services/contact_service.py; EDIT backend/app/schemas.py (add Contacts (CRUD) section after the Members section near line 357).
featureTasks.engineerNotes: Use module-level async functions (match audit.py / custom_fields.py style), NOT a class. validate_and_coerce raises HTTPException(422, detail=[{field,error}]) directly — let it bubble (do not wrap). audit.record does NOT commit; you commit. Build before/after audit dicts from a small explicit field list (first_name,last_name,nickname,suffix,gender,birth_date,phone,email,street_address,contact_type,contact_subtype,custom_data) — do NOT dump the SQLAlchemy object directly (serialization issues with datetime). birth_date is a Date column (models.py:86) — keep it date, not datetime. The custom_fields contact_reference coercion already verifies referenced contacts exist & are non-deleted, so get_contact_detail just needs to resolve ids→chips, not re-validate. For FaceSummary thumbnail you may reuse the _find_first_thumbnail helper pattern from members.py:64 (move/duplicate carefully — or compute a simpler path); keep it best-effort and never let a missing dir raise. event_type filter: Event model (models.py:121-146) has NO event_type column today (it is an S04 addition) — guard with hasattr(Event,'event_type') so the param is accepted-but-ignored rather than crashing. GOTCHA: the duplicate-email warning must be a separate cheap SELECT count, scoped to is_deleted.is_(False), and must NOT block the 201.
featureTasks.constraints: Import audit.record from app.services.audit (never fork it). Call validate_and_coerce from app.services.custom_fields (the intake goal text's 'validate_custom_data' name is WRONG — that symbol does not exist). Use with_for_update() on the PATCH load. contact_type Literal is lowercase. No router/dependencies imports (CN-25). No migration. utc_now() for timestamps.

featureTasks.name: F02 — Backend router: paginated GET /members + CRUD/restore/attendance endpoints
featureTasks.dependsOn: F01 — Backend Contact CRUD service + Contacts schemas
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria:
1. GET /members returns PaginatedContactResponse {items,total,page,page_size}; require_volunteer; query params search(''), page(1), page_size(25, max 100), contact_type, subtype(maps to contact_subtype), tier, is_regular, include_deleted(bool, default False). include_deleted is honored ONLY for admin callers: a volunteer caller passing include_deleted=true still receives NO deleted rows (router forces include_deleted=False unless user role=='admin'); an admin caller with include_deleted=true gets deleted rows.
2. The old bare-list search_members handler (lines 16-61) is FULLY REPLACED — not patched — by a thin wrapper that calls contact_service.list_contacts and returns the paginated DTO. The new search MUST include nickname (this is the P05 fix; the old handler omitted it).
3. POST /members: require_volunteer; status_code=201; body ContactCreate; returns ContactDetailResponse; calls contact_service.create_contact; the structured 422 from validate_and_coerce bubbles unchanged; response carries the warnings list (e.g. ContactDetailResponse has a warnings field OR a wrapper — include warnings in the create response per intake AC).
4. GET /members/{contact_id}: require_volunteer; 200 ContactDetailResponse; 404 for unknown OR soft-deleted when caller is non-admin; admin caller passes allow_deleted=True so soft-deleted returns 200.
5. PATCH /members/{contact_id}: require_volunteer; 200 ContactDetailResponse; partial update via ContactUpdate; external_id in body is ignored (never mutates the stored external_id).
6. DELETE /members/{contact_id}: require_volunteer; 204 No Content; idempotent (second call still 204).
7. POST /members/{contact_id}/restore: require_admin; 200 ContactDetailResponse; 409 when the contact is not currently deleted.
8. GET /members/{contact_id}/attendance: require_volunteer; 200 PaginatedAttendanceResponse; params page, page_size, source, event_type; 404 for unknown contact.
9. GET /members/attendees is retained byte-for-byte (S07 dependency) including _find_first_thumbnail.
10. ROUTE ORDERING: the literal /attendees route AND any other literal sub-paths are declared BEFORE the parameterized /{contact_id} route so FastAPI does not capture 'attendees' as contact_id (recon risk #5). Verify by reading the final file top-to-bottom: GET '' , GET '/attendees', POST '', then GET/PATCH/DELETE '/{contact_id}', POST '/{contact_id}/restore', GET '/{contact_id}/attendance'.
11. No endpoint contains inline business logic — every handler delegates to contact_service. actor_id is derived from user['sub'] (cast int).
12. main.py is unchanged: confirm members router is already included with prefix and (if applicable) check_setup_complete; only touch main.py if that inclusion is missing (recon says it is at line 114 — expect NO change).
featureTasks.filesToChange: EDIT backend/app/routers/members.py (replace search_members handler; add POST/GET-by-id/PATCH/DELETE/restore/attendance handlers; keep /attendees + _find_first_thumbnail); import new schemas from app.schemas and contact_service from app.services.
featureTasks.engineerNotes: Keep prefix='/members' (NOT /contacts) and NO /api prefix — the axios baseURL adds /api on the frontend. Derive actor_id via int(user['sub']). For include_deleted gating: pass include_deleted=(include_deleted and user['role']=='admin') into list_contacts. For GET-by-id admin bypass: allow_deleted=(user['role']=='admin'). DELETE returns Response(status_code=204) with no body — do not set response_model. Put response_model on every non-204 route. GOTCHA: declare /attendees and the bare routes BEFORE /{contact_id}; FastAPI matches in declaration order. The create response needs warnings — if ContactDetailResponse already has an optional warnings:list[str]=[] field (define it in F01), populate it; otherwise return a small create-response wrapper. Keep it consistent with the F01 schema decision.
featureTasks.constraints: Prefix /members, no /api. Roles: GET=require_volunteer, POST/PATCH/DELETE=require_volunteer, restore=require_admin (matches intake F02 ACs — do NOT escalate writes to admin). Retain /attendees unchanged. No main.py change unless router inclusion is missing.

5. New tests pass via npm run test:run: DataTable.test.tsx (renders headers, rows, fires onRowClick, shows loading and empty states), Pagination.test.tsx (prev/next disabled boundaries, page math, size change), FormField.test.tsx (label, required asterisk, error text, hint).

recon.patterns:
Naming conventions:
- Python services: class-based (TaskService) with __init__(self, session) OR module-level async functions; both patterns exist. New contact_service.py should use module-level functions matching the spec description (list_contacts, get_contact_detail, etc.), consistent with audit.py and custom_fields.py.
- Python routers: snake_case function names, APIRouter with prefix + tags, Depends(get_db) + Depends(require_volunteer/require_admin), response_model on every route.
- Schemas: PascalCase Pydantic models, model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) on ORM-mapped response models, Optional fields default None, Literal for constrained string fields.
- Pagination: PaginatedXResponse pattern with fields {total: int, page: int, page_size: int, items: List[X]} — established in PaginatedTaskResponse and PaginatedLogResponse.
- Audit: call audit_svc.record(db, actor_id, action, entity, entity_id, before, after) after db.flush(), before db.commit().
- Soft delete: is_deleted boolean column; queries filter .where(Contact.is_deleted == False); restore sets is_deleted=False.

Frontend patterns:
- Services: plain object with api.get/post/patch/delete calls returning .then(r => r.data), typed with generics (see customFields.ts).
- Hooks: useQuery from @tanstack/react-query with queryKey arrays and queryFn calling service functions; staleTime for caching.
- Pages: functional components, named exports (not default), h-screen flex-col layout with fixed header + scrollable main + BottomNav padding.
- UI components: Tailwind utility classes only, no CSS-in-JS, rounded-xl/2xl for cards, border-border, bg-card, text-foreground tokens.
- Error handling: try/catch in service calls, react-query handles loading/error states, Sonner toast for user feedback.
- Auth: useAuthStore (Zustand) for token/role, ProtectedRoute/AdminRoute wrappers in routing.
- Modal accessibility: role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby, focus trap, Escape key handler (see MemberSearchModal.tsx and ConfirmDialog.tsx).
